country.description: The two-letter country code of the organization, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format

mapPoint.description: The centerpoint coordinates of the organization, calculated from the default site and seperated by a comma

measuredTreesUri.description: URI pointing to GeoJSON data containing tree planting data for this site

measuredTreesBlob.description: GeoJSON blob containing tree planting data for this site (max 10MB)
